The '''Third Age mage''' is a monster that is spawned when fighting [[The Mimic]]. It is spawned alongside the [[Third Age Ranger|Third Age ranger]] and [[Third Age Warrior|Third Age warrior]]. It does not need to be defeated to beat The Mimic.
